evaluation_scope: All layers and query heads. Evaluation-model operands and study outcomes have not been loaded or inspected before these choices. Public configurations and literature were known.
development_scope: Qwen0.5 and Smol360 outputs were inspected during development. Smol360 is not an untouched test, even though it is outside the affine calibration family.

predictor.features: Exact full-pair, row-centered Q/K storage-noise second moment from covariance products; reference softmax-Jacobian/value sensitivity.
predictor.output: Score-only first-order relative squared-Frobenius error; no measured FP8 output error used as a feature.
predictor.calibration: One affine OLS map of log1p(relative Frobenius error), fit only Qwen-family rows; same slope/intercept for all variants and evaluation models.

rotation_classifier.observation: One physical model/layer/query head, averaging the three text-level log errors.
rotation_classifier.ties: Exact observed ties are reported separately and are binary non-hurt. Exact predicted zero does not predict hurt.
rotation_classifier.threshold_selection: Fixed zero threshold; no sweep or test-guided tuning.

prefix_sink_diagnostic.probabilities: Ideal causal FP64 probabilities from captured native BF16 post-RoPE Q/K.
prefix_sink_diagnostic.physical_head_definition: Mean prefix4 attention mass over query positions 128..1023 and the three texts >= 0.5.
prefix_sink_diagnostic.interpretation: Operational prefix-concentration label, not a paper-defined permanent head identity or a causal explanation of downstream harm.

attention.reference: Unmodified native Transformers SDPA BF16 attention.
attention.fp8: E4M3 Q/K/V and unnormalized probability storage; FP32 grouped32 products and online recurrence; BF16 output.
attention.rotation: Shared row-vector Q/K diag(random signs) times normalized Hadamard; V unchanged. PCG64/order/seed are emulator choices, not uniquely prescribed by FA3.

downstream.metrics: 1024 next-token labels per text; full-vocabulary CE, exp(CE), KL(BF16 || variant).
downstream.scope: Raw-text batch teacher forcing, reset context, no chat template. Disjoint from capture/fit, not guaranteed excluded from model pretraining.
downstream.limitation: Full-K centering and current-block scales can depend on later batch tokens; not streaming-decoder perplexity or generation.

statistical_scope: Descriptive held-out-model evaluation. Texts, layers and GQA-sharing heads are dependent; no independent-trial significance claim.
